before: Single-address lookup followed by a separate saved-address book; no consolidated BNT device dashboard.
changes: Dedicated BNT dashboard with automatic reads of all account-saved BNT bindings
Address-deduplicated total hashrate, total paid and confirmed unpaid balances, with per-field coverage
Stale hashrate excluded from current total; cached historical balances explicitly marked
Colored mining, zero-hashrate, older-data and unavailable states
Device/name/address/Worker search, status filters, hashrate sorting, cards and list view
Per-device Worker shares/timestamps and pending-payment details
Multiline address saving, optional names, linking to existing devices, optional Worker filter, renaming and removal through existing authenticated fleet mutations
Validation before batch mutation, remaining-address retention after partial failure and one-time tab-local login draft
Five languages and responsive mobile layout; advanced add fields collapsed
Anonymous query remains separate from saving; empty state has address help
dataBoundaries: No invented BNT daily earnings, USD quotes or historical trend series
Workers use pool share activity, not device heartbeats
Wallet balances remain wallet scoped even for Worker-filtered cards
Preview fixtures never enter production database or live query cache
No production writes, migrations, push or deployment

validation.targetedTests: 25 passed, one optional live test skipped in the offline suite
validation.realPool: BNT_LIVE_TEST=1: all six BNT tests passed using the public Seine developer address
browser: Real public pool lookup rendered hashrate, balances and Workers
Attention filter selected the older-data device
Preview rename updated the device heading
Preview removal reduced the device list
Worker expansion showed last share time
Mobile add dialog verified after contrast correction

preserved: Pre-existing analytics and other local changes were preserved and are outside this work.
